name: Reply on 174 pieces of ANW-2116-PG.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
After the short talk on WeChat, this is a formal confirmation about below points
1, Enclosure
last time we used 24 port enclosure(port 17~port 24 holes are still there), we discussed a new casing(just port 1~16 for copper)
Cost is 10usd/pc
2, PVC mask
Last time we made 100pcs. Now there is 92pcs left, we need to make a new batch.
100pcs: 2.3usd/pc
300pcs: 1.5usd/pc
Which one do you prefer?
3, Please get ready the MAC address list.
About other information, user manual&label format...
We will keep it the same as last order if there is not a change at your side.
4, Deduction
200usd software cost
2% RMA(plus last order, its totally 182pcs=174pcs+8pcs), so we will deduct 2 pieces from the total amount(chargeable quantity 172pcs)
Or we still do 174pcs and send 2 extra spare pieces for immediate replacement or something(total 176pcs).
This is up to you.
Discount: we are going to give y
ou 5% discount for this order(this will be based on quantity and accumulative order volume)
5, Payment
Last time we had a meeting and talked about this.
In our daily work, we do 50%-50% while you proposed 30%-70%
Considering this is the first bulk order, lets do 30%-20%-50%
30% before production, 20% in production and 50% before shipment.
If it goes smooth, lets do 30%-70%
But please know that this is ONLY applicable to standard/non-customized models.
About customized models, lets discuss.
6, Shipping options
Its 174pcs(or 176pcs), packing information is like this
545*495*420mm, 5pcs in each carton, 21Kg each
535*205*300mm, 2pcs in each carton, 8.5Kg each
That will be 32 cartons+2/3 cartons=around 700Kg
UPS: 5~10 days to arrive, 7K usd
This is the best option, for DHL/FedEx, shipping time is similar, while cost is more.
Maybe we should think about sea shipment or some other options, air service is too expensive.
7, Leadtime
I will check internally and put it in PI after everything is finalized.
[页眉页脚]
s.sagatelecom@gmail.com

www.sagatelecom.com.cn
